newsitem.title: USA: Amway Asia Pacific launches stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Amway Asia Pacific launches stock buyback.

text.p: Amway Asia Pacific Ltd said Monday it was commencing an offer to buy back up to 3.5 million shares of its common stock, or about 5.8 percent of the total outstanding.
The purchase price is US$40.875 per share, the company said.
Directors said the offer will improve both the earnings per share and the return on equity applicable to the common stock.
The offer also affords the company the opportunity to mitigate the impact of certain U.S. tax laws by reducing its cash, the company said.
If the number of common shares tendered is in excess of the 3.5 million authorized, tendered stock will be accepted on a pro rata basis.

Amway said it had been informed by its principal shareholders that, except for the Jay and Betty Van Andel Foundation and the Richard and Helen DeVos Foundation, the principal shareholders do not intend to tender any shares under the offer.
